editorial.name: Brutask
editorial.descriptionZh: Brutask 把待办清单、时间盒和视频房拼成一个给远程小团队用的虚拟办公室，定位在个人效率而不是项目进度。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看黑线插画怎么把效率工具讲得不像工具
editorial.noteZh: 首屏左右各一幅黑白线描插画（喝咖啡的、抱笔的、看手机的人），中间是绿色图钉形的 Brutask 站标，标题 Making virtual me more human!，副题说它是 simplest collaboration tool for remote teams looking to boost their efficiency by increasing individual productivity，绿色按钮 Get started。下面一条黄色跑马灯反复滚 Timebox and prioritise、Add team members、Assign tasks、Join rooms、Attend meetings、Integrate Google Calendar、Stay connected、Create to-do list，正文写 Brutask is less like a tool and more like your virtual office! 与 We've cracked the code of remote working for teams，并用 Make meetings more exciting!、Hang out with the team during break times! 解释 Spaces。功能四块是 Add Tasks、Time Boxing、Prioritisation、Video Calls、Connect Calendar，定价段标题叫 Pay as you grow。
editorial.pricing: Paid（Our plan starts from $15 for 10 users and $2 per additional user）

reasons.statement: 交付物是订阅制的远程协作应用（Our plan starts from $15 for 10 users and $2 per additional user），导航只有 Spaces、Pricing、Blog、Login，没有可复制的设计或代码产物，归产品与公司官网。
拿不准：Add Tasks 与 Time Boxing 像待办工具、Video Calls 与 Join rooms 又像会议工具，本词典没有对应小类，故按产品官网归档。

facts.evidence: 导航 Spaces（带黄色 Beta 标）与跑马灯里的 Join rooms、Attend meetings 两项。

facts.value: Other task managers are all about project progress, Brutask focuses on increasing individual productivity
